title: AudioTrackList
description: The audio streams of one media source.

detail.description: What the player should say when the list is empty or incomplete.

tracks.description:
Streams in container order. Empty means selection is unavailable, not that the video
is silent: `detail` says why.

AudioTrack.description:
One audio stream the preview can play.

The browser cannot switch a `<video>` element's audio track, and the engine's decoder
graph is not exposed to the page. The service therefore lists the container's audio
streams and serves a selected one as its own audio-only file.

channels.description: Channel count when it can be read from the stream description.

codec.description: Codec name as the container reports it, for example `aac` or `opus`.

default.description: Whether the container marks this stream as the default.

index.description: Zero-based index among audio streams, which is ffmpeg's `0:a:N` selector.

label.description: A complete label for the player's selector.

language.description: ISO 639 language tag when the container carries one.
